title: Noise-preprocessed tester
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a tester with a finite seed and a probability law on its seeds, and let $\delta\in[0,1]$. Define a new tester by first drawing a seed according to the law of $T$, then independently applying noise with parameter $1-\delta$ to each query of the check selected by that seed; the resulting check uses the same predicate and the noisy queries.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ has a finite seed type and a probability law on that type
